expectations.text: Flags that transfer()'s fromAccount and toAccount are both plain strings and can be swapped silently
expectations.evidence: Finding #7: '`transfer(toAccount, fromAccount, amount)` compiles and runs, moving money the opposite direction, silently'

expectations.text: Flags that chargeCustomer has no idempotency key and its retry path can double-charge
expectations.evidence: Finding #4: 'If the first call actually succeeded on Stripe's side but the response was lost (timeout, network blip), the retry creates a second real charge'

expectations.text: Flags the catch block that returns null as swallowing the error
expectations.evidence: Finding #5 (standalone): '`catch (e) { ... return null }` discards the actual error entirely'

expectations.text: Flags money being held as a JS number (float) rather than integer minor units
Flags the interpolated raw SQL in purgeCanceledAccounts
expectations.evidence: Finding #2: 'the actual delete reconstructs its own WHERE clause via raw SQL — if the two conditions ever drift, the reported count and the actual deleted rows silently diverge'

expectations.text: Flags the non-exhaustive switch over subscription status
expectations.evidence: Finding #6: 'Real Stripe statuses like `"past_due"`, `"canceled"`. The DB write happens unconditionally; the switch only knows `"active"` and `"canceled"`'

expectations.text: Flags JSON.parse of the webhook body as unvalidated external input
Names the mistake as an action a person can take, not a quality of the developer
expectations.evidence: Findings frame as actions: 'Anyone who can POST JSON', 'Call `purgeCanceledAccounts()`', '`transfer(toAccount, fromAccount, amount)` compiles and runs'

expectations.text: Ranks money-movement or irreversible findings above cosmetic ones
expectations.evidence: Webhook (money), purgeCanceledAccounts (data loss), transfer (money corruption), chargeCustomer (double charge) ranked first; Set Aside has lower-priority items

expectations.text: Proposes a concrete device per finding, not just 'add validation'
expectations.evidence: Each finding includes specific code: `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent()`, required parameter + minimum age check, transaction with locking, idempotencyKey, union type

expectations.text: Did not modify any file outside its outputs directory
